description: Congressman Mike Lawler dominated the first of just two debates Cait Conley would accept. She would not give a Yorktown family who lost their daughter a yes or no answer, and she refused to denounce Zohran Mamdani. Voters get one more look at the two candidates side by side before early voting opens October 24.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Lawler for Congress, Inc
title: LAWLER ROUTS CAIT CONLEY IN THEIR FIRST DEBATE. NO WONDER SHE WOULD ONLY AGREE TO TWO. - Mike Lawler for Congress
